scenario: Call-level cooldown inside a rule that also carries a rule-level cooldown rejects with DS_VALIDATE_CALL_COOL_INSIDE_RULE_COOL — the two rate-limit surfaces compose unpredictably and the spec disallows nesting them on the same activation chain. Pin: `rule r cooldown 5_min: ... -> call svc.foo cooldown: 2_min` rejects (rule already throttles; call-level cooldown is redundant or contradictory). The compile-time error keeps the per-activation rate behavior unambiguous.
rules_ds:
service svc.foo:
    """stub"""
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 5_min:
    Trig
->
    call svc.foo cooldown: 2_min

service svc.foo:
    kwarg dummy: Int
